description: This Java class `InsertWithUuidDataChange` extends `InsertDataChange` and overrides the `generateStatements` method to add a UUID column with a generated value if not already specified, facilitating insert operations with UUIDs in a database.

classes.name: InsertWithUuidDataChange
classes.description: A class extending InsertDataChange that adds a UUID column with a generated UUID value during insert operations if not already specified.

methods.name: generateStatements
methods.description: Overrides the method to insert a UUID column with a generated value if it does not already exist in the columns.
